senses.gloss:
Dhurandharadarga
--Dakṣināmūrtistotra. Burnell 202b.

Dhurāgāna
or Dhūrgāna. Sv. BBRAS. 594. BORI. 340 of 1883-84. BORI. D. I. i. 146. BP. p. 284.

Dhurāsāma
Sv. RASB. II. 1257. See above.

Dhūrgānicandrikā
dh. R. A. Sastri II. p. 186.
C.. Dhurāgāna above.

Dhūrjaṭāstotra
See Dhūrjaṭistotra (or Agastyāṣṭaka), Adyar D. IV. 683.

Dhūrjaṭi
poet. Skm. p. 110 (Lahore edn.). verse 782 (Calutta edn.).

Dhūrjaṭirāja
poet. Skm. p. 32 (Lahore edn.). verse 204 (Calcutta edn.).

Dhūrjaṭistotra
Adyar I. p. 233b. Adyar D. IV. 683. See Agastyāṣṭaka.

Dhūrtakāmadatta
prakaraṇa. Q. by Śiṅgabhūpāla in Rasārṇavasudhākara. Śg. I. p. 10. TSS. edn. p. 285, verse 216.
C.. Kāmadatta.

Dhūrtacarita
Q. in Sāhityadarpaṇa. N. S. Press edn. p. 345. [Page302-b]

Dhūrtacarita
bhāṇa. by Madhusūdana, brother of Kavicandrācārya alias Divākara (a. of Bhāratāmṛtakāvya, MT. 3717).
Mentioned by the latter. See ibid. a. of this work is not Divākara a. given on p. 44b. above.

Dhūrtacaritra(kathā)
Jain. BP. p. 247a. Jainagranthāvalī p. 254.

Dhūrtanartaka
prahasana. ridiculing Śaiva ascetics. composed a. the end of 16th Cent. by Sāma Rāja. Oxf. 138b. 139a. RASB. VII. 5372. Mentioned in Kāvyenduprakāśa, BORI. D. XII. 142.
For a. analysis of the play see Wilson, Select Specimens of the Theatre of the Hindus Vol. II. p. 410ff.; C. Cappeller, Gurupūjākaumudī (Festschrift A Weber). p. 59 ff.
See Wint. HIL. III. (Eng. Transl.) p. 299.
Ed.. Ramachandra Tarkalankara. Calcutta, 1828.

Dhūrtabhāṣya
Bhor 31. Dhūrtasvāmin's work ?.

Dhūrtarāśi
ins. poet. son of Divākara. composed the Vasantgadh incription of Varmalata (A. D. 625). Epi. Ind. IX. p.. 187-92.

Dhūrtaviṭa
śravya kāvya of Nidarśana type mentioned by Bhoja in his Śṛṅgāraprakāśa (See Raghavan's Bhoja's Śṛṅgāraprakāśa, p. 817).
C.. Dhūrtaviṭasam3vāda.

Dhūrtaviṭasaṃvāda
bhāṇa. by Īśvaradatta. GD. 1491C. TCD. 1285A. Tra. Ad. Rep. 1110. 45 (a..). Trav. Uni. 5968B (inc.). C. 2360A. Triv. Cur. VII. 158 (inc.).
See Baroda II. 15146 (Bhāṇatrayī).
Q. thrice by Abhinavagupta in his C. on Nāṭyaśāstra. [Page303-a.
Pt.. (1) Caturbhāṇī, Dakṣiṇabhāratī Skt. Series. Madras, 1922. (2) Śṛṅgārahāṭa. Bombay, 1959.

Dhūrtaviḍambana
prahasana. by Amareśvara, son of Dhyāneśvara; grandson of Dharmeśvara of Kāśyapagotra an. native of Harihansa in the region of Tīrabhuktī.
AK. 510. BORI. 510 of 1891-95. BORI. D. XIV. 86. RASB. VII. 5339.

Dhūrtaviḍambana
prahasana. by Maheśvara. America 2275. K. 70. (a..).

Dhūrtasamāgama
prahasana. by Jyotirīśvara Kaviśekhara. composed in 1324 A. D. See JASB. 1907, p. 207. On his date see Wint. HIL. III (Eng. transl.) p. 297.
Allahabad 191 (14). Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 55. America 2262. B. II. 118. Bikaner 3158. BL. 63. BORI. 80 of Ā883-84. BORI. D. XIV. 87. Burnell 168b. Cabaton I. 690 (I). Dacca 412 (fr.). Gough p. 33. IO. 4201. L. 85. MT. 2380 (inc.). Nasik II. 587 (a..). Nepal I. p. 66. NS. Press 191 (with C.). Oxf. 140a. Paris (B85b.) Peters. II. p. 189 (no. 80). Pheh. 6. RASB. VII. 5340. 5341. Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p. 23. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 81 (no. 288). Stein 77. TD. 4630-32. Trav. Uni. 7637. Viśvabhāratī 807.
Pt.. (1) Christianus Lassen. Bonn, 1838. (2) C. Cappeller. Jena, 1883.
Transl.
French. C. Schoebel. Revue. Orientale et Algerienne 3. 1852.
Italian. Antonio Marazzi. Milan, 1874.
--C. NS. Press 191.

Dhūrtasvāmin
--C. on Āpast. gṛhyasūtra. Hpr. III. 149 (p. 97). [Page303-b]
--C. on Āpast. śrautasūtra.
Pt.. (1) Mysore Govt. Ori. Lib. Ser. 87. 1944. (2) Pt. II. GOS. 142. 1963.
--C. on Paribhāṣāsūtras or Sāmānyasūtras from Āpast. śr. sū. TD. 2052.
See NCC. II. p. 134a. This is prob. by Rudradatta.
Addl. ms.: BORI. 19 of 1883-84.
--C. Bhāṣya on Bodhāyanasūtra. Oppert II. 7409.

Dhūrtasvāmibhāṣyaṭīkā
or ºdīpikā. by Kauśikarāma or Rāmāgnicit or Rāmāṇḍār.
See C.. on Dhūrtasvāmin's C. on Āpast. śr. sūtra. NCC. II. p. 138a.
Addl. mss.: Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 55 (2 mss.; inc.). America 179. BORI. 88 an. 89 of 1887-91. 7 of 1902-7. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 2 (inc.).

Dhūrtākhyāna
Jain. a.. Arrah I. A. p. 16 (ptd.). BP. p. 161b (Ākhyānaka 5). Chani 835 (in verse). 836. 3466. Dāhilakṣmī XXVI. 15. Pannalal Bombay III. p. 19.
--C. Bālāvabodha. Chani 508.

Dhūrtākhyāna
Jain. Skt. BORI. 1378 of 1891-95. This is prob. a Skt. rendering of the next. See Jinaratnakośa I. p. 199a.

Dhūrtākhyāna
or dhuttakkhANa Jain. Pkt. in five Ākhyānas in 485 verses on the adventures of five rogues. by Haribhadrasūri, disciple of Yākinī Mahattarā.
BORI. 407 of 1879-80 (Gujarati version). 1314 of 1887-91. 1378 of 1891-95. 335 of 1895-98. BORI. D. XIX. i. 2. 306-09. D. p. 147. Jainagranthāvalī p.. 100. 162. JBhP. I. 1337 (Bālāvabodhakathā). Peters. VI. p. 88 (no. 335).
See Wint. HIL. III (Eng. transl.) p. 386. [Page304-a.
Pt.. Singhi Jain. Ser. 19. 1944.

Dhūrtānanda
a collection of erotic verses. GD. 1433A. Granthappura p. 74, no. 1433a. MT. 2775 (a. (diff. text). (in 4 paddhatis).
